We have the Meridian Receivables Fund transaction on the table -- a $12 million pool of commercial receivables, with Meridian's draft proposal at $11.7 million plus customary seller support for collection shortfalls. Before I can authorize this, I need to run our standard cross-functional pre-closing review. I'd like to hear from each of you -- legal, credit risk, servicing operations, and financial crime compliance -- on any unresolved items or conditions you need satisfied before we close. Let's start with legal.
